about_the_game:
Warning: This is a demo version of Satan's Dungeon and includes only the first chapter of the game. The full experience, with all five interconnected endings and expanded narrative elements, will be available in the complete release.

First-Person Philosophical Horror – Explore, solve puzzles, escape enemies, and experience the beginning of a deep, interconnected story.

Step into the eerie world of Satan's Dungeon in this demo, a first-person horror experience that blends psychological terror with intricate puzzles and a non-linear narrative. In this playable preview, you will explore an abandoned tunnel, encounter a mysterious mirror, and find yourself trapped in a sinister dungeon.

Throughout this demo, a cryptic voice will guide you as you solve challenging puzzles and evade lurking dangers. Using mirrors, you can glimpse the memories of past prisoners, uncovering clues about the dungeon’s dark past.

What’s Included in This Demo:

  • The first chapter of Satan's Dungeon

  • A taste of the game’s unique environmental storytelling and puzzle mechanics

  • The atmospheric horror experience that sets the tone for the full game

  • A limited selection of endings based on your choices

This is just the beginning of the nightmare. The full game will expand upon this foundation with a non-linear story, deeper mysteries, and multiple interconnected endings.

Are you ready to take your first step into Satan’s Dungeon?

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes memories of individuals who were present in this location in the past, each of whom has committed crimes. Players may encounter corpses or crime scenes, but there is no direct depiction of murder or sexual content.
